method: No-vig sportsbook anchor (FanDuel via TheLines/FanDuel Research, BetMGM via SportsBettingDime, consensus via TheSpread, Novig), then RESEARCH.md stats (moves capped at 4 points). The gamma API and polymarket.com were NOT approved for this unattended run, so Polymarket prices come only from defirate.com's Polymarket US table (TNF, Oct 28 ~23:00Z); bids for spread/total are ask-1c estimates. Event slug nfl-car-gb-2026-10-30 verified on predscope ($3.7M liquidity); spread/total slugs follow the usual pattern and are NOT verified. CFB and NBA legs have NO Polymarket price (ask null): the offline run skips them; the live run on the Mac prices them if the guessed slugs resolve (slugs NOT verified).

legs.label: NFL TNF: Packers ML vs Panthers
legs.why: Anchor: FD GB -196/CAR +164 => GB 63.6% no-vig; BetMGM -189/+155 => 62.5%; consensus -200/+170 => 64.3%; avg ~63.5%. Line moved toward CAR (GB -220 -> -200, spread -4 -> -3.5) against 55% of tickets. Injuries: CAR OUT EDGE Phillips, G Lewis, G Simpkins, T Moton, T Ekwonu (4 OL starters), CB Evans; CB Horn and Jackson on IR; Young (knee) full practice, no designation. GB OUT C Rhyan, LB Franklin; Parsons PUP; WR Golden and DT Wyatt Q; Love healthy. Last games: CAR lost 43-13 to TB (Young 14/27, 2 INT, 5 sacks); GB lost 20-17 at DET. GB allows 13.5 ppg last 4, 6th in points/play allowed (0.313) vs CAR 26th (0.427). GB rushing last in NFL (59.8 ypg) vs CAR 105.3. H2H: CAR won 16-13 at Lambeau in 2025 as a 10+ dog. EPA n/a. Weather n/a (forecast page failed). CAR OL collapse is on the report since early week and the market still moved to CAR, so only +0.5: 64% vs Polymarket US ask 64.8c = -1c.

legs.label: NFL TNF: Panthers +3.5 at Packers
legs.why: Anchor: FD CAR +3.5 -106/GB -114 => CAR 49.1%; BetMGM -108/-111 => 49.7%; Novig +100 => 50%; ~49.5%. Stats as gb-ml. For CAR: line moved their way vs tickets, CAR 13-0 ATS after an outright loss (weak trend), GB 4-11-1 ATS last 16 as favorite, GB 28th 3rd down and 30th red zone (kicks FGs). Against CAR: 4 OL starters out vs GB front, two top CBs out vs Love (270+ yds in 4 of 5). Net -0.5: 49%. Polymarket US 'Packers win by 4+' 51c => CAR +3.5 ~49c. Edge 0.

legs.label: CFB: James Madison ML vs Troy
legs.why: Anchor: FD JMU -1053/Troy +720 => JMU 88.2%; consensus -1200/+700 => 88.1%. Spread -19.5 (opened -20.5), FD -18.5. JMU 7-1 (only loss 34-31 OT at App State last Thursday, so a full week of rest), 41.4 ppg (2nd), allows 18.3 and 110 rush ypg. Troy 3-4, lost 4 of 5, lost to winless ULM; QB Crowder playing hurt (shoulder; 6/14 50 yds 1 INT last game); WR1 Keyes doubtful; Troy on a short week. JMU RB1 Pettaway (824 yds) OUT, already priced (line dropped 1). Beat Troy 31-14 in the 2025 SBC title game. +1: 89%. NO POLYMARKET PRICE (not reachable); slug guessed.
